question: 单项选择：I _____ this book yesterday. A. read  B. have read  C. am reading  D. will read
answer: 答案：A. read。解析：yesterday是一般过去时，强调过去时间。read的过去式是read（发音/red/）。

question: 单项选择：I _____ this book. I know the story well. A. read  B. have read  C. am reading  D. will read
answer: 答案：B. have read。解析：现在完成时强调与现在的联系（I know the story well）。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：I ______ (visit) my grandparents last weekend.
answer: 答案：visited。解析：last weekend是一般过去时。完整：I visited my grandparents last weekend.

question: 单项选择：— Have you read this book? — Yes, I _____ it last month. A. read  B. reads  C. have read  D. will read
answer: 答案：A. read。解析：last month是过去时间，回答用一般过去时。read的过去式是read（发音/red/）。

question: 翻译句子：昨天我看了那本有趣的书。
answer: 答案：I read that interesting book yesterday. 解析：yesterday是一般过去时。

question: 单项选择：I _____ my hometown three years ago. A. leave  B. left  C. have left  D. will leave
answer: 答案：B. left。解析：three years ago是一般过去时。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：She ______ (be) to Paris three times.
answer: 答案：has been。解析：three times强调经历，用现在完成时。完整：She has been to Paris three times.

question: 单项选择：He _____ in London in 2010. A. lives  B. lived  C. has lived  D. is living
answer: 答案：B. lived。解析：in 2010是过去具体时间，用一般过去时。

question: 翻译句子：我从来没有去过日本。
answer: 答案：I have never been to Japan. 解析：never"从未"是现在完成时标志。

question: 单项选择：I _____ this book before. A. read  B. reads  C. have read  D. will read
answer: 答案：C. have read。解析：before"以前"是现在完成时标志。
